# Simple Dev Tools

Simple Dev Tools is a local-first browser toolkit built by Jonathan R. Reed through Hello.World Consulting. It gives engineers small utilities for snippets, diagrams, SQLite, regex, schemas, security tokens, IDs, QR codes, timestamps, JSON, color checks, diffs, file hashes, markdown previews, and querystring editing without an account or hosted workspace.

The project is intentionally plain: open the tool, inspect or transform the input, copy or export the result, and leave without sending private implementation details to a backend. It is part of Jonathan R. Reed's public project network around practical tools, private workflows, and inspectable systems.

## Data Boundaries

- Tool input is handled in the browser.
- The site has no account layer and no database-backed workspace.
- Some tools use browser APIs, local WebAssembly, or bundled client libraries.
- Do not paste production secrets, private keys, customer records, or regulated data into any public utility unless your own policy allows that use.

## Developer Accelerators

- [API Snippet Generator](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/api-snippet/): Generate cURL, Python requests, and JavaScript fetch snippets from an endpoint, HTTP method, custom headers, bearer token, and JSON body.
- [Mermaid Editor](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/mermaid/): Sketch sequence diagrams, flowcharts, and architecture visualizations quickly with live preview and export.
- [SQLite Playground](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/sqlite/): Run SQL experiments against an in-memory SQLite database (sql.js WASM) with instant result tables and CSV/JSON export.
- [Regex Lab](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/regex/): Iterate on regular expression patterns with explainers, tests, and sharing capabilities.
- [IDs & Scheduling](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/ids-cron/): Generate ULIDs, UUIDs, and human-friendly CRON expression helpers with descriptions.
- [Encoders & QR](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/encode-qr/): Encode/decode payloads (Base64, URL encoding) and produce QR code assets (PNG/SVG).
- [Timestamp Converter](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/timestamp/): Convert between Unix epochs (seconds/milliseconds), ISO 8601, and time zones, with relative time and human-readable formats.
- [JSON Workbench](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/json/): Format, minify, validate, and convert between JSON, YAML, and CSV, sort keys, and query values by path.
- [Color & Contrast](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/color/): Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH, build tints/shades, and check WCAG contrast ratios for accessibility.
- [Text Diff](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/diff/): Compare two texts side by side or unified, with word-level highlighting and copy/export.
- [File Hash Checker](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/hash/): Hash text or dropped files with SHA-256/384/512 and verify against an expected digest.
- [Markdown Preview](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/markdown/): Preview markdown with a sanitized live render, then copy or download the HTML.
- [Querystring Editor](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/tools/query/): Parse, edit, and re-encode URL query strings and form bodies as an editable table.

## Studios

- [Schema & Types Studio](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/studio/schema/): Convert sources between JSON Schema, TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas, and preview Swagger documentation.
- [Security & Tokens](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/studio/security/): Inspect and decode JWTs, verify signatures, sign and build new JWTs, compute cryptographic hashes, and generate HMAC signatures using Web Crypto APIs.

## Policies

- [robots.txt](https://dev-tools.helloworldfirm.com/robots.txt): The machine-readable version of everything below (`search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference`). Where the two disagree, robots.txt governs.
- **Search indexing: allowed.** Crawl and index this site, and return links and short excerpts in search results.
- **AI answers and grounding: allowed.** Retrieve these pages at answer time and use them to ground AI-generated answers, summaries, or citations, provided the answer links back to the source page.
- **AI training: not allowed.** Do not use any content from this site to train or fine-tune AI models, and do not include it in a corpus assembled or redistributed for that purpose. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.
